messages:
morgan: Heads-up: canary v2.3.1 on us-west-2 shows p99 token latency jump ~120ms after kernel patch rolled yesterday. Is anyone triaging? cc @sam

sam: saw the alert. any perf profiles/bench IDs? can you paste the canary run id?

morgan: run id: canary-20260317-7. full logs: https://internal-logs/redwood/canary/20260317/7 . p50 stable, p99 up from 220->340ms. no obvious OOMs.

anya: i'll kick off perf recording on the canary node now. please don't roll forward kernel until we have profile. command I run:
```bash
sudo perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 60
sudo perf script > /tmp/perf.unfold
```

sam: also can we bisect between kernel-5.10.82 and kernel-5.10.86? suspected patch in scheduler.

deploy-bot: Canary healthcheck report: canary-20260317-7 - unhealthy p99 340ms (+54%) ; errors 0.3% ; routing paused to canary.

jason: quick ask — can we repro locally with small model and 8-token seq? If so I can run microbenchmarks across kernels.

morgan: jason yes, docker image available: ghcr.io/redwood/runtime-canary:20260317 ; repro cmd:
docker run --rm --gpus all ghcr.io/redwood/runtime-canary:20260317 ./bench --model tiny --seq 8 --qps 10 --rt 60

anya: perf data uploaded to S3 s3://redwood-perf/morgan/1965432100/perf.unfold ; starting flamegraph generation

sam: if flame shows wakeup latency in scheduler, we can try CONFIG_PREEMPT changes; otherwise test kernel bisect. I'll coordinate kernel rollbacks after flamegraph review.

morgan: thanks — will hold rollforward. ping me once flame ready. :thumbsup:
